backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments with blob storage, study planner tasks with daily/weekly views, and access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three requirements for a second processing pass in notes cleaner that detects and splits long bullet points with multiple action phrases into separate bullets for specific formatting modes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including pages for assignment formatting, study planner, notes cleaner, leave application, resume builder, feature requests, and supporting components/hooks.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Contains the single numeric value '73' representing the current production draft version.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documentation explaining the production version management system where production-version.txt contains a single numeric draft version to promote to Live/Production channel via CI/CD.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes with student-friendly soft purple/blue aesthetics.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, title 'StudentSathi Student Helper Website', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages (home, assignment, study planner, notes cleaner, leave, resume, feature request), ThemeProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Multi-language chatbot component with voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, message history, download options (PDF/Word/Text), and content insertion for assignment assistance.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with sticky header, responsive navigation (desktop and mobile sheet menu), and footer. Includes links to all major features and a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable button component with multiple variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon). Supports asChild prop for composition.
Card component primitives including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter with consistent styling and spacing.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Sheet (side panel) component with context-based state management, supporting four sides (left, right, top, bottom), backdrop overlay, and close functionality.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder Toaster component that returns null; intended for future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: AI assistant chat interface with voice input, image OCR (Tesseract.js), text-to-speech, and assignment generation workflow. Manages conversation state, confirmation dialogs, and saves chat history.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Documentation file indicating that DailyProgressChart.tsx should remain unchanged during weekly chart fixes.
Daily progress visualization with donut chart showing completed vs pending tasks, plus a stats grid displaying completion counts and total study time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Container component that conditionally renders either DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on viewType prop.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Small badge component displaying subject name with color-coded styling based on subject type or custom color.
A searchable dropdown component for filtering study tasks by subject, displaying subject names with task counts and highlighting the selected subject.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: Displays a donut chart and statistics grid showing weekly study progress, including total tasks, completed/pending counts, and total study time for completed tasks only.
frontend/src/components/UserGuidelineDoc: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for feature requests, assignment generation (frontend-only), conversation saving, and study planner task management with backend actor integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: Hook that persists and manages the study planner sort mode preference (default or dateTime) in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: Hook that independently persists subject filter state for daily and weekly views in localStorage, returning the appropriate filter based on active view.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: Hook that persists the study planner view mode (daily or weekly) in localStorage, defaulting to weekly view.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for theming (light and dark modes) including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
Page component for creating and formatting academic assignments with multi-language UI support, title page configuration, format settings (font, spacing, page numbering), content editor with word count, AI improvement, and export options (PDF/Word/Text). Includes subject-specific heading templates, reference format helpers, and a teacher checklist for assignment requirements.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page that displays a hero section and grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request Feature) with navigation to respective pages.
Page for generating formal leave application letters for students by collecting name, date, and reason inputs, then producing a formatted letter with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Page that transforms rough notes into clean, formatted text with options for bullet conversion, paragraph-to-points transformation, definition styling, and auto-heading detection. Includes copy and download (.txt) functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Feature request submission page where users can describe needed tools/features with optional email contact, using a mutation hook to submit requests to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: React component for a resume builder page that allows users to input personal details, education, skills, and projects, then generates a formatted text resume that can be copied to clipboard.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: Main Study Planner page component with daily/weekly views, task management (add/toggle/delete), subject filtering, sorting, progress charts, and PDF/TXT export. Supports both authenticated (backend) and guest (localStorage) modes.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Defines bullet style configuration for Notes Cleaner, currently locked to dash style ('-') with future support planned for dot, number, and arrow styles.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Core formatting engine for Notes Cleaner that auto-detects headings, applies smart semantic splitting to preserve compound terms and complete sentences, and converts text to bullet points while avoiding over-splitting.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Handles TXT file download for cleaned notes, auto-generating filenames from the first word and current date or using custom names provided by the user.
Utility functions to parse duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours', '30 minutes') into minutes and format minutes back into human-readable duration strings.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages guest-mode task storage in localStorage for Study Planner, providing CRUD operations and handling legacy task upgrades by stripping deprecated colorOverride fields.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Generates a printable HTML document from study tasks and opens it in a new window for PDF printing. Includes task details, completion status, and summary statistics formatted for clean printing.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting utilities for study tasks with two modes: default (by task ID) and dateTime (chronological with tasks lacking dates sorted to end). Uses task ID as tiebreaker for stable sorting.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Handles conversion between HTML date/time inputs and backend timestamp formats (bigint nanoseconds for backend, number milliseconds for guest). Provides formatting functions for displaying date and time values.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports study tasks to a plain text file with Notepad-friendly formatting. Creates a downloadable TXT file with task details, completion status, and summary counts.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides weekly date calculation utilities for study planner, handling both backend bigint nanoseconds and guest number milliseconds. Includes functions for getting week boundaries, checking if dates fall within current week, and normalizing date values.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Centralized subject-to-color mapping system with predefined colors for common subjects. Provides functions to get badge and indicator color classes for subjects with dark mode support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support. Includes functions to store, retrieve, and clear parameters from both URL and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, sidebar/chart/card colors, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for an academic note cleaning tool that implements multi-pass semantic splitting of compound action phrases in bullet points, with thresholds of 8+ words during formatting and 10+ words in post-cleaning, applied only to specific formatting modes.
unknown.txt: Requirements document describing an assignment formatting tool with features including editable student fields, word counter, PDF/Word/text download, subject heading insertion, citation helper, teacher checklist, AI improvement, and an embedded Urdu-language chatbot assistant (Student Sathi) fixed at bottom-right with context-aware help and assignment generation capabilities.
